comment: How the maker's own app prints a brim, for every process tier of every Prusa model and nozzle, where the presets have no key for it: every whole loop the brim width fits, odd counts too (brim_loop_rounding whole), grown from the first layer outline after elephant foot compensation, so the gap to the object stays the brim gap at any compensation (brim_use_efc_outline). A Prusa project read sets the same two. Applied last to resolved/prusa.json by packages/settings/scripts/apply-overlay.ts, which gen-resolved.ts also runs. Values are in the profiles' own format.

source.process: Prusa stock print presets (0.20mm SPEED) on the MK4 IS, MK4S, MINI IS, XL IS, XL 5T, CORE One and CORE One L

every_process.comment: Keys the Prusa process presets do not set. brim_loop_rounding: whole, where the settings default rounds down to an even count. brim_use_efc_outline: on, where the settings default grows the brim from the outline before compensation.
